title: Ticket confirm nahi, phir bhi paise kyun kate?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [sarcastic] Tumhara WL ticket... confirm nahi hua.
Chart bante hi ticket khud cancel.
Ye clerkage hai... har passenger pe 60.
3 saal me railway ne aise 1229 crore kamaye!
Aise aur railway raaz... follow karo!
caption:
WL ticket confirm hi nahi hua... phir bhi refund me paise kam aaye? 🚆💸

Raaz: clerkage charge. Chart bante hi jo e-ticket poora waiting me reh jaata hai, wo khud cancel ho jaata hai aur kiraya wapas aata hai, par har passenger pe ₹60 clerkage kaat ke (AC class me upar se GST). WL/RAC ticket tum khud cancel karo, tab bhi yahi ₹60 katta hai.

Aur IRCTC ki convenience fee? Wo cancel hone pe wapas nahi hoti.

RTI (Business Standard, March 2024): 2021 se January 2024 tak 12.8 crore se zyada waiting tickets cancel hue, aur railway ko inse ₹1,229 crore mile.

Clerkage hatane ka proposal June 2025 me aaya tha, par March 2026 ke refund rules me bhi WL/RAC cancel pe ₹60 clerkage hi likha hai (Business Today).

Tumhare kitne paise aise kate? Comment karo 👇
